verses.1: These were the sons of David who were born to him in Hebron: the firstborn, Amnon, the son of Ahinoam the Izzrahite; the second, Daniel, the son of Abigail the Carmelite;
verses.2: the third, Absalom, the son of Maacah, daughter of Talmai, king of Geshur; the fourth, Adonijah, the son of Haggith;
verses.3: the fifth, Shephatiah, the son of Abital; the sixth, Ithream, the son of his wife Egla.
verses.4: Six children were born to him in Hebron, where he reigned for seven years and six months. In Jerusalem he reigned for thirty-three years.
verses.5: The following were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon—four, the sons of Bath-shua, daughter of Ammiel.
verses.6: Also born to him were: Ibhar, Elishama, Eliphelet,
verses.8: Elishama, Eliadah, and Eliphelet—nine in total.
verses.9: These were all the sons of David, apart from the sons of his concubines. His sister was Tamar.
verses.10: Solomon’s son was Rehoboam, whose son was Abijah, whose son was Asa, whose son was Jehoshaphat,
verses.11: whose son was Joram, whose son was Uzziah, whose son was Joash,
verses.12: whose son was Amaziah, whose son was Azariah, whose son was Jotham,
verses.13: whose son was Ahaz, whose son was Hezekiah, whose son was Manasseh,
verses.14: whose son was Amon, whose son was Josiah.
verses.15: The sons of Josiah were: the firstborn, Johanan; the second, Jehoiakim; the third, Zedekiah; the fourth, Salum.
verses.16: The sons of Jehoiakim were: Jeconiah, his son; Zedekiah, his son.
verses.17: The sons of Jeconiah were: Assir, Shalathiel, his son;
verses.18: Melchiiram, Pedaias, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedayah.
verses.19: The sons of Shalathiel were: Zerubbabel, Meshullam, Hananiah, and Shimeath, his sister.
verses.20: Hashub, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Yushab hesed—five in total.
verses.21: The son of Hananiah was Phalti and Yishaiah. These were the sons of Rehoboam’s descendants: the sons of Arnun, the sons of Obadyah, the sons of Sekhanyahu.
verses.22: The sons of Sekhanyahu were: Shemaiah, and the sons of Shemaiah were: Chatath, Yigal, Bariah, Nearyah, and Shefat—six in total.
verses.23: The son of Nearyah was Elioenai, Hezekiah, and Ezerikam—three in total.
verses.24: The sons of Elioenai were: Hodavyahu, Eliashiv, Phalyah, Akub, Johanan, Deliyahu, and Anani—seven in total.

notes:
Notes
- v. 9: "His sister was Tamar" — the Hebrew uses "tamar" (תָּמָר) as a proper name, which may also be a reference to the tree "tamar" (date palm), but it is treated as a name here.
